summary: The transcript resolved the only material ambiguity with one necessary question, and the final contract is implementation-ready. Repository fidelity is effectively complete because there was no repository evidence to constrain or contradict the contract. Owner-decision recall is very high: the contract captures the request shape, supported values, default-preservation rule, full-string uppercase transformation point, non-letter preservation, exact examples, and scope control, with only minor loss of the oracle’s broader illustrative edge-case examples.
